Library

Yinyang files and shared updates

This guide owns the file and update contract for the maintained Yinyang package. The collection is Prometheus2Heraclitus; this complete member lives under skills/yinyang/. Its references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ are supporting resources, not independent Skills. Obtain the complete directory from the public repository and expose it through the consumer's actual Skill mechanism. The website is a reading surface; repository cloning and GitHub's native ZIP preserve complete source.

Yinyang is one developed philosophy and formation method. Readers can adopt it, combine selected resources, or create a different work. The example and commons essay develops that invitation. A philosopher's thought may inform a framework; it cannot replace the account of the actual user. This guide's six-file and common-update contract applies to full adoption of the maintained Skill. Reading its philosophy or borrowing a selected method does not by itself adopt that contract or require a personal philosophy project.

Common and situated content

This implementation distinguishes six public writing guides from six private actual files, corresponding by object:

Object Public guide Private actual file
Orientation references/formation/orientation.md references/situated/orientation.md
Person references/formation/person.md references/situated/person.md
Counterpart references/formation/counterpart.md references/situated/counterpart.md
Relationship references/formation/relationship.md references/situated/relationship.md
Environment references/formation/environment.md references/situated/environment.md
Revision references/formation/revision.md references/situated/revision.md

The public guides have complete Chinese editions and explain how to form the corresponding content. The actual files articulate one's own orientation, personal understanding, actual counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision method. Revision guidance and an actual revision method are distinct too: the former offers adaptable writing guidance; the latter explains how revision works with this person's philosophy, material, and actual environment. Public distribution contains guides, with no actual files or placeholder portraits. The initial reading uses all six actual files; a common guide cannot substitute for one of them.

For full adoption, the model forms these six files from relevant authorized material and organizes their needed private support. Explicit unknowns can be honest content; copying guidance or someone else's portrait cannot form an actual version. Person, counterpart, and relationship remain three modeling objects; the other files supply direction, realization, and revision. Later changes follow affected meanings and dependencies.

references/personal/sources.md is the private evidence entrance supporting the six actual files. Extended history, originals, and topical material stay with existing owners or under references/personal/, reached through access-bounded locators. The revision writing guide supplies evidence guidance. Independently authored philosophy has its own source; private support links it and retains relevant grounds.

Both entire trees, references/situated/ and references/personal/, are private. Everything else is common package content, including the entrypoint, six writing guides, essays, diagrams, and scripts. Distributed copies and private copies choosing continued common updates keep common content byte-identical. Using Yinyang owns the actual initial reading; Philosophy and models connects the writing objects.

Project common changes

scripts/sync-common.py checks common source projection by default. With --apply, it projects common files into the target, preserving everything under both private trees, including additional files and links. It does not traverse or inspect their contents. It does not infer a person, export private files, or publish to a runtime.

Start a new situated version from a complete shared copy, then form its private accounts. Compare explicit package directories:

python3 /path/to/shared/yinyang/scripts/sync-common.py \
  --source /path/to/shared/yinyang --target /path/to/situated/yinyang

Add --apply to copy changes, then run the comparison again. Unmatched target files and common-path symlinks stop copying; inspect ownership rather than silently deleting them. Existing local or private Web owners install and publish the projected source, followed by actual-consumer readback.

Earlier packages mixed public guidance and private content at references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md. The projector refuses either package with any of these paths before changing files. Their owner first redistributes actual meaning into the six actual files and private evidence index, preserves unique support, and retires the old paths. The old encounter can contain orientation and relationship, and the old relationship both counterpart and joint activity: a mechanical rename cannot complete this semantic migration. Retain any useful private references/personal/README.md substance at the appropriate private owner; the whole personal tree is protected.

Common parity preserves one recipient-local discovery exception: when the target's single-line SKILL.md description already begins with 用户自制：, the projector retains that prefix while replacing its substantive wording from the common source. An unmarked target stays unmarked. Every other common byte and file mode remains source-owned; the public package does not assign itself recipient-relative authorship.

This parity applies to copies choosing continuing common updates. If you replace the philosophy or organization independently, keep that work at its own source and maintain its coherent references. Do not project this common package over it, even if it retains the six-slot format.

Authors of other works can change the number and organization of accounts and the philosophy. The maintained Yinyang implementation keeps these fixed six actual files.

Personal and public boundaries

Personal accounts remain private even when formalized or written for models. Private quotations, biography, psychological and health records, relationship narratives, account information, private paths and conversation identifiers, and unpublished manuscripts stay with their actual owners. General abstraction does not authorize public links that reconstruct private sources.

Return only authorized reusable insights to the collection. Yinyang original material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; other independent members retain their own MIT licenses. Follow the collection guide and the actual publication owner for permissions, attribution, and source review. A private adaptation need not be published.
